name: The Famous
address: Boulevard de l'URSS, Mini Prix Bastos, Yaoundé, Cameroon
description: A stylish bistro-cafe in Bastos known for international and gastronomic cuisine, including sushi, pasta, French dishes, Asian specialties and grilled meats.
bonASavoir: The restaurant has two levels, a modern interior and a lounge atmosphere. It is particularly known for dinners, events and a varied international menu. Dishes start from around 6,000 FCFA.
